destination.title: Neutrino masses: symmetries, gravity and observable consequences
destination.question: How can neutrino masses be generated or protected, and how do ultraviolet constructions, conditional gravity criteria and observations constrain their realization?
destination.summary: The numerical proposal contains several useful research directions, with different systems, mass hypotheses, targets and methods. Its memberships support navigation, not a single mechanism or universal neutrino-mass bound. No original scientific region statement was supplied beyond the numerical membership proposal.

systems: Neutrino sectors in field-theory, gravity–matter, string-inspired and extra-dimensional models
Related charged-fermion, dark-matter and proton-protection sectors
targets: Mass generation, suppression and neutrino nature
regimes: Broken and unbroken symmetries as separately specified
Four-dimensional models, diagnostic compactifications and physical extra dimensions
assumptions: Conjectures and model assumptions remain conditional and source-specific
A shared overview card does not establish a shared scoped question
conventions: Source dates and version-specific statements are retained
Proposed singletons preserve exact source questions without asserting cross-source uniqueness
includes: Proton protection when explicitly coupled to neutrino-mass compatibility
Observational constraints without a claimed gravity origin
excludes: A universal preference for Dirac neutrinos
Treating quark-only hierarchy or lepton-asymmetry generation as identical to neutrino-mass generation

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the absence of stable anti-de Sitter vacua restrict low-energy parameters of theories coupled to gravity? The closing discussion uses this consistency condition to motivate implications for neutrino masses, the cosmological constant and the electroweak hierarchy.

sources.title: Large star/rose extra dimension with small leaves/petals

evidence.text: Can one graph-compactified extra dimension provide a large volume, a weak-scale KK gap and TeV-scale gravity without a large leaf length, while also generating small Dirac neutrino masses?

sources.title: Gravitational interactions and neutrino masses

evidence.text: Can global symmetries, broken only by nonperturbative gravity, explain tiny Dirac neutrino masses through symmetry-preserving Planck-suppressed operators and predict axion dark matter or observable neutrino decays?

sources.title: Towers and hierarchies in the Standard Model from Emergence in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can loop-generated kinetic terms from quantum-gravity towers explain SM flavour hierarchies and small Dirac neutrino masses, while additional Swampland conjectures relate the electroweak, tower and supersymmetry-breaking scales to the cosmological constant?

sources.title: Fermion masses and mixings in the supersymmetric Pati-Salam landscape from Intersecting D6-Branes

evidence.text: Which models in the previously enumerated 33-model supersymmetric Pati–Salam landscape possess viable Yukawa textures, and how far can three- and four-point interactions accommodate charged-fermion masses, Dirac-neutrino masses, CKM mixing and PMNS mixing?

sources.title: Neutrino data analysis of extra-dimensional theories with massive bulk fields

evidence.text: How do bulk Dirac masses and brane Yukawa couplings affect neutrino-oscillation constraints on the compactification radius in ADD+ and Dark Dimension models?

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signature and the Nature of Neutrino Masses: Majorana, Dirac, or Pseudo-Dirac?

evidence.text: Can gravitational-wave spectra indirectly distinguish Majorana, Dirac, and pseudo-Dirac neutrinos in B−L extensions that generate approximately 0.1 eV masses without extremely small Yukawa coefficients?

sources.title: Neutrinos, B-L symmetry and the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can a bulk gauged B−L symmetry in the Dark Dimension explain the required right-handed neutrinos through anomaly cancellation, generate active neutrino masses after B−L breaking, and satisfy gauge-boson bounds?

sources.title: Neutrino Masses with Enhanced $B-L$ Symmetry

evidence.text: Can relaxing right-handed-neutrino charge quantization yield anomaly-free gauged B−L interactions that are strong for neutrinos, compatible with tiny Dirac masses, and testable beyond baryonic fifth-force searches?

sources.title: High-quality axion from chain seesaw

evidence.text: Can one gauged extension generate Dirac masses for both charged fermions and neutrinos through universal seesaw chains while protecting an accidental Peccei–Quinn symmetry against dangerous gravity-induced breaking?

sources.title: Majorana Neutrino Physics and Matter-Antimatter Asymmetry in Type IIA String Theory

evidence.text: Can Type IIA D2-instanton Majorana masses accommodate neutrino oscillation parameters and the baryon asymmetry, and what restrictions follow from mass ordering, flavour amplitudes and swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Models of neutrino mass with a low cutoff scale

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional theories with a low cutoff protect against excessive baryon/lepton violation while generating small Majorana or Dirac neutrino masses through infrared gauge-symmetry breaking?

sources.title: Neutrino oscillations without neutrino masses or heavy mass scales: A Higher dimensional seesaw mechanism

evidence.text: Can bulk right-handed neutrinos generate light neutrino masses without an intrinsic heavy seesaw scale, and can mixing with massive Kaluza-Klein states produce oscillations when a neutrino mass eigenvalue vanishes?

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Substitute the assumed neutrino mass formula into the eigenmass cap while holding the Yukawa, vacuum energy and specified extra spectrum fixed.

sources.title: Large star/rose extra dimension with small leaves/petals

evidence.text: The author adapts Kurasov distribution theory to discontinuous graph test functions and constructs actions whose boundary terms avoid undefined squared Dirac distributions. Hamilton's principle supplies bulk equations and natural vertex conditions; Henningson–Sfetsos terms select the fermionic boundary variation.

sources.title: Gravitational interactions and neutrino masses

evidence.text: Organize effective operators by global charge and Planck suppression. Charge-violating operators receive an assumed instanton factor e^{−|ΔQ_g|S}; neutral higher-dimensional operators need not carry this exponential suppression.

sources.title: Towers and hierarchies in the Standard Model from Emergence in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Estimate one-loop kinetic metrics by summing tower states below the species cut-off. For the chosen linear masses and couplings, the dominant fermion metric scales as N0^3 ≃ (Mp/m0)^2; heavier independent towers give g_i ∼ (ΛQG/m0^(i))^3.

sources.title: Fermion masses and mixings in the supersymmetric Pati-Salam landscape from Intersecting D6-Branes

evidence.text: Adopt RGE-evolved unification-scale mass targets and historical UTfit (2023) and NuFIT 5.3 (2024) inputs. Fit target matrices by fine-tuning Higgs VEVs against geometric brane shifts and Kähler-dependent couplings; displayed mixed-matrix targets use entrywise magnitudes.

sources.title: Neutrino data analysis of extra-dimensional theories with massive bulk fields

evidence.text: The exclusion statistic is Δχ²=−2 log(LBSM/LSM), with LSM the best three-flavor likelihood. Separate normal- and inverted-ordering analyses produce contours labeled 90% and 99% confidence.

sources.title: Theory and phenomenology of Dirac neutrinos

evidence.text: How can symmetry-protected seesaw and radiative mechanisms explain small Dirac neutrino masses while connecting neutrino nature to dark matter stability, flavour predictions and observable charged lepton flavour violation?

sources.title: Unbroken B – L symmetry

evidence.text: Can unbroken gauged B−L with Dirac neutrinos remain phenomenologically viable, and what bounds constrain its coupling over the testable mass range when light right-handed neutrinos are included?

sources.title: Effects of Planck Scale Physics on Neutrino Mixing Parameters in Left-Right Symmetric Models

evidence.text: Can explicitly D-parity-breaking, Planck-suppressed operators significantly alter tree-level neutrino masses and mixing in left-right symmetric models, particularly when an additional scalar singlet permits dimension-five operators?

sources.title: Species scale associated with Weinberg operator and bound on Majorana neutrino mass

evidence.text: Can neutrino-associated towers define a perturbative species scale for the Weinberg operator, and can ordering it below the gravitational species scale yield a lower bound on Majorana neutrino mass without relying on circle-compactification arguments?

sources.title: Anomalous Majorana Neutrino Masses from Torsionful Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum torsion, gravitational axial anomalies and additional axions generate a gauge-invariant right-handed Majorana neutrino mass without spontaneous symmetry breaking, and what controls its size?

sources.title: On the impact of Majorana masses in gravity-matter systems

evidence.text: How do independent left- and right-handed Majorana masses affect matter fixed points, Yukawa UV completion and scalar-quartic predictivity in an asymptotically safe gravity–Higgs-Yukawa toy model?

sources.title: Constraining feeble neutrino interactions with ultralight dark matter

evidence.text: How strongly can terrestrial neutrino oscillations and cosmology constrain an ultralight dark-matter scalar that induces a time-dependent right-handed-neutrino Majorana mass, especially when neutrinos form nearly degenerate pseudo-Dirac pairs?

sources.title: Collider signatures of mirror fermions in the framework of a left-right mirror model

evidence.text: Can a left-right mirror model tied to a tiny-neutrino-mass scale leave accessible first-family mirror fermions, and can their pair production yield observable jet–Z resonances at the LHC?

sources.title: Dark matter stability and Dirac neutrinos using only Standard Model symmetries

evidence.text: Can the SM's existing B−L symmetry, with suitable new fields and spontaneous breaking, simultaneously protect Dirac neutrinos, forbid tree-level neutrino masses, and stabilize particles that generate neutrino masses radiatively?

sources.title: Swampland constraints on neutrino masses

evidence.text: Can the AdS distance conjecture and an absolute-value extension of the dS conjecture constrain neutrino masses without assuming stability of compactified AdS vacua, including when dark energy is quintessence?

sources.title: TeV scale supersymmetric standard model and brane world

evidence.text: Can the low-unification-scale TSSM protect proton stability and small neutrino masses through anomaly-free gauge symmetries, while preserving its unification prediction and yielding distinctive phenomenology?

sources.title: On small Dirac neutrino masses in string theory

evidence.text: Can string vacua yield tiny Dirac masses for all neutrinos while retaining unsuppressed SM gauge, quark and charged-lepton couplings, and suppressing right-handed Majorana masses?

sources.title: Horizontal gauge symmetry and masses of neutrinos

evidence.text: Can spontaneous breaking of a gauged family symmetry explain both very heavy right-handed neutrinos and much lighter left-handed neutrinos, with Majorana rather than purely Dirac masses?

sources.title: Proton Stability and Light $Z^\prime$ Inspired by String Derived Models

evidence.text: Can a family-universal Abelian gauge symmetry motivated by free-fermionic heterotic models protect the proton down to a low breaking scale while remaining anomaly free and allowing fermion masses and a neutrino seesaw?

sources.title: Constraining the EW Hierarchy from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can requiring acceptable lower-dimensional vacua of the Standard Model coupled to gravity restrict four-dimensional neutrino parameters and the Higgs vev? The paper compares Majorana and Dirac realizations through their infrared Casimir spectra.

sources.title: Neutrino mass generation in asymptotically safe gravity

evidence.text: Within asymptotically safe gravity, must neutrino masses require additional matter fields, is the type-I Seesaw scale bounded, and can pseudo-Dirac neutrinos be accommodated?

sources.title: Neutrino Masses from Generalized Symmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Can non-invertible chiral symmetries protect vanishing neutrino masses while motivating UV gauge effects that generate exponentially small Majorana or Dirac masses from charged-lepton Yukawas?

sources.title: Fermion masses and mixings in string theory with Dirac neutrinos

evidence.text: Can the enumerated supersymmetric Pati–Salam landscape accommodate observed fermion masses and mixings while producing tiny Dirac-neutrino Yukawas, unsuppressed other Yukawas and gauge couplings, and neutrino masses compatible with the quoted experimental and swampland constraints?

sources.title: Further swampland constraint on Dirac neutrino

evidence.text: Can anomaly-free U(1) twists of circle-compactified Standard Model fields, together with the non-SUSY AdS or AdS distance conjecture, further constrain Dirac neutrino masses and the surviving B−L symmetry?

sources.title: Searching for neutrino-modulino oscillations at the Forward Physics Facility

evidence.text: Can a swampland-motivated model with high-scale supersymmetry breaking produce a light modulino whose mixing with active neutrinos is accessible to Forward Physics Facility experiments?

sources.title: Neutrino masses from large extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can naturally small Dirac or Majorana neutrino masses arise in a brane world with a fundamental gravitational scale near a TeV, without a superheavy right-handed Majorana mass or a conventional seesaw?

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional black string, and can its horizon develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to exterior observers in finite asymptotic time?

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional vacuum black string, and does its evolution imply a naked singularity in finite time measured by asymptotic observers?

sources.title: End Point of Black Ring Instabilities and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: What are the nonlinear endpoints of black-ring instabilities, and can sufficiently thin rings provide evidence for weak cosmic censorship violation in asymptotically flat five-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: End Point of the Ultraspinning Instability and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the axisymmetric ultraspinning instability of six-dimensional Myers–Perry black holes, and does its evolution provide evidence for a violation of weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein--null dust system with an inner mirror

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, Cauchy-stable perturbations of AdS develop trapped surfaces through repeated reflections, in the spherically symmetric Einstein–null dust model with a shrinking inner mirror?

sources.title: The Einstein--null dust system in spherical symmetry with an inner mirror: structure of the maximal development and Cauchy stability

evidence.text: Does an inner reflecting mirror restore well-posedness for spherical Einstein–null dust with AdS asymptotics, and can Cauchy stability be controlled uniformly as the mirror radius shrinks?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein-massless Vlasov system

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, smooth, spherically symmetric perturbations of AdS develop trapped spheres under Einstein–massless Vlasov evolution with reflecting conformal infinity, without an inner mirror?

sources.title: The characteristic initial-boundary value problem for the Einstein--massless Vlasov system in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Establish characteristic well-posedness, continuation criteria and low-regularity finite-time Cauchy stability of AdS for the spherically symmetric Einstein–massless Vlasov system with reflecting conformal infinity.

sources.title: Null Fluid Collapse in Rastall Theory of Gravity

evidence.text: Under what conditions does spherical null-fluid collapse in Rastall gravity produce physically admissible, strong-curvature naked singularities, and when are they locally or globally visible?

sources.title: Predictivity lost, predictivity regained: a Miltonian cosmic censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can weak cosmic censorship be amended to accommodate controlled naked-curvature examples while preserving useful classical predictivity and allowing only minimal exposure of Planck-scale physics?

sources.title: Holography abhors visible trapped surfaces

evidence.text: Does consistency of the classical holographic dictionary force trapped surfaces behind event horizons, establishing this consequence of weak cosmic censorship without assuming the full initial-data conjecture?

sources.title: Quantum censors: Backreaction builds horizons

evidence.text: Can quantum matter backreaction protect weak cosmic censorship whenever a reliable semiclassical spacetime description exists, and can quantum Penrose inequalities test this beyond perturbatively weak backreaction?

sources.title: Gravitational collapse and cosmic censorship

evidence.text: Does gravitational collapse from nonsingular, asymptotically flat initial data generically keep singularities and their effects inaccessible to distant observers? This review addresses weak cosmic censorship, rather than strong cosmic censorship.

sources.title: Comments on cosmic censorship in AdS / CFT

evidence.text: Can HHM-type scalar initial data force weak cosmic-censorship violation through insufficient conserved energy to cloak the collapsing region, while retaining a well-behaved dual field theory?

sources.title: Black strings and p-branes are unstable

evidence.text: Are extended, uncharged black strings and p-branes linearly stable under small gravitational perturbations, and what might an exterior instability imply for compactification and cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Evidence for an Electrifying Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can localized electric boundary forcing in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS Einstein–Maxwell theory drive smooth initial data toward arbitrarily large curvature visible to distant observers, providing a counterexample to the version of cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Violating the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Four-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Can initially pure four-dimensional AdS, driven by a localized boundary electric field, develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to boundary observers, violating the version of weak cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Testing the Weak Gravity - Cosmic Censorship Connection

evidence.text: Does adding a sufficiently charged scalar remove the proposed electrically driven AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and does the minimum charge needed for regular endpoints coincide with the proposed AdS weak-gravity bound?

sources.title: Attempts at vacuum counterexamples to cosmic censorship in AdS

evidence.text: Can boundary differential rotation produce vacuum AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship by driving stationary solutions beyond a finite rotation amplitude, and what role do boundary ergoregions play?

sources.title: Further evidence for the weak gravity — cosmic censorship connection

evidence.text: Does charged matter satisfying the appropriately modified weak gravity bound remove the boundary-driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship when a dilaton or a second Maxwell field is added, and is that bound necessary?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship in Born–Infeld electrodynamics and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Do boundary-driven Einstein–Born–Infeld solutions in AdS provide counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and can a sufficiently charged scalar remove them? How do the inferred charge thresholds depend on the Born–Infeld parameter?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with self-interacting scalar and bound on charge to mass ratio

evidence.text: How do quartic and hexic scalar self-interactions change the minimum scalar charge required to remove a previously identified class of weak cosmic censorship counterexamples in asymptotically AdS Einstein-Maxwell theory?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with SU(2) gauge field and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Does adding a charged azimuthal component of an SU(2) gauge field remove a known class of AdS weak-cosmic-censorship counterexamples, and is there a minimum charge sufficient to obtain regular solutions at large boundary electric amplitude?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with excited scalar fields and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Do first- and second-excited charged scalar fields remove the electrically driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and is there a minimum scalar charge protecting regularity?

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: A flow method locates the apparent horizon. Its area, embedding shape, areal radius, and normalized curvature invariants constructed from Riemann contractions are monitored. Convergence tests supply error estimates where available.

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: Track the apparent-horizon radius, area, intrinsic embedding geometry and two curvature invariants evaluated on the horizon. Apparent horizons are found with a flow method; convergence comparisons supply some reported errors.

sources.title: End Point of Black Ring Instabilities and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: GRChombo supplies adaptive mesh refinement, fourth-order spatial finite differences and RK4 time integration, using 8–13 refinement levels. The horizon interior has at least 50 grid points after gauge adjustment; periodic boundaries are placed sufficiently far away to avoid boundary contamination during the runs.

sources.title: Evidence for an Electrifying Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Apply the DeTurck method with a planar Schwarzschild–AdS reference metric. Metric and gauge functions depend on two compact coordinates, with prescribed asymptotic data and regularity at the axis and horizon.

sources.title: End Point of the Ultraspinning Instability and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Use a general parametric apparent-horizon surface because a single-valued radial graph fails late in the evolution. Solve the expansion and parameter-gauge equations as an elliptic system using Newton line search; projecting out pure gauge corrections improves robustness.

sources.title: Violating the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Four-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Characteristic numerical evolution uses null geodesics angled by tan ψ=c/R, rather than boundary-normal characteristics, to cover an extremal horizon. Residual radial coordinate freedom keeps ξ=0 at an apparent horizon.

sources.title: Constraints on high-order gravitational theories from weak cosmic censorship

evidence.text: Can imposing weak cosmic censorship as a classical admissibility principle constrain higher-curvature gravitational theories, using first-order accretion experiments and a condition computable from extremal near-horizon data?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture, overcharged shells and gravitational traps

evidence.text: Can classical Einstein–Maxwell theory admit extended spherical objects with gravitational mass m<|Q|, and can their evolution avoid naked singularities while supporting trapped gravitational perturbations?

sources.title: Classical and thermodynamic stability of black branes

evidence.text: Under what assumptions does local thermodynamic instability imply a classical Gregory–Laflamme instability, and conversely, for black branes with noncompact translational symmetry? Does the instability disappear in a finite neighborhood of extremality?

sources.title: Constraints on Low-Energy Effective Theories from Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can weak cosmic censorship constrain higher-derivative Einstein-Maxwell EFT coefficients through attempts to overcharge an initially extremal, nonrotating black hole with infalling charged matter?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture requires the existence of exotic AdS black holes

evidence.text: If a classically extremal AdS4–Kerr–Newman black hole stable against superradiance decays through smaller black holes, what restrictions follow for the daughters' specific angular momenta, horizons and compatibility with classical Cosmic Censorship?

sources.title: GRChombo: An adaptable numerical relativity code for fundamental physics

evidence.text: What software capabilities make GRChombo adaptable to numerical-relativity problems in fundamental physics, particularly systems requiring flexible mesh topology or modifications of standard binary-black-hole evolution?

sources.title: Instabilities of the Small Black Hole: A View from N=4 SYM

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled thermal N=4 SYM reveal a counterpart of the Gregory–Laflamme localization instability of the small AdS5 black hole smeared on S5, through R-charged unstable directions and symmetry-breaking saddles?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Does the reconstructed regular interior survive inhomogeneous perturbations and arise from gravitational collapse without producing a different singularity? These questions determine whether the background construction can describe a dynamically realized black hole.

sources.title: Cosmic Censorship of Trans-Planckian Field Ranges in Gravitational Collapse

evidence.text: What scalar-field excursions arise dynamically during gravitational collapse, and are order-one Planck-unit excursions hidden behind horizons? This reverses the heuristic argument that sufficiently large spatial field variations themselves cause black-hole formation.

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Can RN-AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence and a string cloud satisfy the paper's weak-gravity charge-to-mass criterion while retaining a horizon at a restricted-phase-space thermodynamic critical point?

sources.title: Noncommutativity and the Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can a massless noncommutative scalar probe dress an AdS3 naked singularity with a BTZ horizon, consistently with weak cosmic censorship, and yield a quantum-complete effective spacetime?

sources.title: Space–time singularities and cosmic censorship conjecture: A Review with some thoughts

evidence.text: Which physical processes threaten weak or strong cosmic censorship, how should generic initial conditions be defined, and can semiclassical or quantum effects preserve predictability?

sources.title: Gravitational collapse: The role of general relativity

evidence.text: Which features of relativistic stellar collapse survive departures from spherical symmetry: horizons, singularities, a predictable exterior endpoint and extractable energy? Can collapse from reasonable nonsingular initial conditions instead produce a visible singularity?

sources.title: Black holes and wormholes in (2+1)-dimensions

evidence.text: Which black-hole spacetimes arise from discrete AdS3 identifications with time-symmetric initial data and one asymptotic region, and how do interior topology, horizon formation, trapped curves and topological censorship behave?

sources.title: Cosmic-quantum connections: Assessing the viability of weak gravity and weak cosmic censorship conjectures in Kerr-Newman-Kiselev-Letelier black hole

evidence.text: Can spin, a string cloud, and a quintessence term permit horizon-bearing extremal Kerr–Newman–Kiselev–Letelier configurations with Q²/M²>1, which the authors interpret as compatible with both the mild weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Analyzing WGC and WCCC through charged scalar fields fluxes with charged AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter in the CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar absorption and superradiant emission preserve weak cosmic censorship while supporting the weak gravity conjecture for RN–AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, within holographic CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Cosmic censorship for AdS5-Kerr

evidence.text: Does cosmic censorship exclude physically problematic five-dimensional AdS–Kerr geometries, and can superradiance, brane nucleation, or an additional holographic mass bound eliminate the remaining large-specific-angular-momentum cases?

sources.title: Penrose Inequality as a Constraint on the Low Energy Limit of Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can BF-allowed tachyonic scalar matter violate the AdS Penrose inequality while preserving the null energy condition?

sources.title: Gravitational Instabilities and Censorship of Large Scalar Field Excursions

evidence.text: Can localized transplanckian scalar excursions evade gravitational censorship through smooth higher-dimensional completion, and do classical instabilities supply an alternative censorship mechanism?

sources.title: Holographic Dual of The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What constraints do cosmic censorship and its proposed WGC modification impose holographically on boundary matter, especially the number of colours Nc, and could these constraints obstruct realistic QCD models?

sources.title: Black hole production in particle collisions and higher curvature gravity

evidence.text: Can classical Einstein gravity and the closed trapped surface argument reliably justify the geometric black-hole production cross section σ ∼ πRSchw(E)² in transplanckian particle collisions when collision-induced curvature and higher-curvature corrections are considered?

destinations.title: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional black string, and can its horizon develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to exterior observers in finite asymptotic time?

What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional vacuum black string, and does its evolution imply a naked singularity in finite time measured by asymptotic observers?
What are the nonlinear endpoints of black-ring instabilities, and can sufficiently thin rings provide evidence for weak cosmic censorship violation in asymptotically flat five-dimensional gravity?

What is the nonlinear endpoint of the axisymmetric ultraspinning instability of six-dimensional Myers–Perry black holes, and does its evolution provide evidence for a violation of weak cosmic censorship?
Can arbitrarily small, Cauchy-stable perturbations of AdS develop trapped surfaces through repeated reflections, in the spherically symmetric Einstein–null dust model with a shrinking inner mirror?
Does an inner reflecting mirror restore well-posedness for spherical Einstein–null dust with AdS asymptotics, and can Cauchy stability be controlled uniformly as the mirror radius shrinks?
Can arbitrarily small, smooth, spherically symmetric perturbations of AdS develop trapped spheres under Einstein–massless Vlasov evolution with reflecting conformal infinity, without an inner mirror?

Establish characteristic well-posedness, continuation criteria and low-regularity finite-time Cauchy stability of AdS for the spherically symmetric Einstein–massless Vlasov system with reflecting conformal infinity.
Under what conditions does spherical null-fluid collapse in Rastall gravity produce physically admissible, strong-curvature naked singularities, and when are they locally or globally visible?
Can weak cosmic censorship be amended to accommodate controlled naked-curvature examples while preserving useful classical predictivity and allowing only minimal exposure of Planck-scale physics?

Does consistency of the classical holographic dictionary force trapped surfaces behind event horizons, establishing this consequence of weak cosmic censorship without assuming the full initial-data conjecture?

Can quantum matter backreaction protect weak cosmic censorship whenever a reliable semiclassical spacetime description exists, and can quantum Penrose inequalities test this beyond perturbatively weak backreaction?

Does gravitational collapse from nonsingular, asymptotically flat initial data generically keep singularities and their effects inaccessible to distant observers? This review addresses weak cosmic censorship, rather than strong cosmic censorship.
Can HHM-type scalar initial data force weak cosmic-censorship violation through insufficient conserved energy to cloak the collapsing region, while retaining a well-behaved dual field theory?
Are extended, uncharged black strings and p-branes linearly stable under small gravitational perturbations, and what might an exterior instability imply for compactification and cosmic censorship?
